subject: CNC machine procurement
body: We need one CNC turning centre for the Manufacturing Lab. Please collect three technical and commercial quotations. The requirement note is attached.

subject: CNC machine procurement
body: Quotations received: Vendor A INR 18.4 lakh, Vendor B INR 17.9 lakh, Vendor C INR 19.1 lakh. Vendor B is lowest, subject to technical compliance.

subject: CNC machine procurement
body: Technical committee found Vendor A does not meet the spindle speed range. Vendor B meets all mandatory specifications and offers delivery within eight weeks. Vendor C is compliant but has a longer delivery period.

subject: CNC machine procurement
body: The department recommends Vendor B at INR 17.9 lakh based on technical compliance and commercial comparison. Please approve procurement.

subject: CNC machine procurement
body: Approved. Proceed with Vendor B for INR 17.9 lakh, subject to standard purchase terms and budget confirmation. Purchase section may initiate the purchase order.

subject: CNC machine procurement
body: Accounts confirmed budget availability. Purchase order is being prepared. Please issue it to the vendor by 11 September 2026.

subject: CNC machine procurement
body: Purchase order has been sent to Vendor B. Vendor acknowledged receipt and confirmed the eight-week delivery schedule. Delivery and installation remain pending.

subject: Bonafide certificate requests
body: Final-year students need bonafide certificates for scholarship renewal. Please confirm required documents and processing timeline.

subject: Bonafide certificate requests
body: Students must submit institute ID copy and current semester fee receipt. Applications received by 16 September will be processed by 20 September.

subject: Bonafide certificate requests
body: Please circulate the requirements. The department office will verify enrollment before forwarding complete applications to the Registrar.

subject: Bonafide certificate requests
body: 42 applications were received before the deadline. Four are incomplete because fee receipts are missing. The remaining 38 verified applications have been forwarded to the Registrar.

subject: Bonafide certificate requests
body: 38 bonafide certificates are ready for collection. Four incomplete applications remain on hold pending fee receipts.

subject: Annual technical fest venues
body: Annual technical fest is proposed for 14-16 November 2026. We request Main Auditorium and Central Lawn. Please confirm availability.

subject: Annual technical fest venues
body: Main Auditorium is available on all three dates. Central Lawn is available on 14 and 15 November only due to maintenance on 16 November.

subject: Annual technical fest venues
body: Outdoor activities can move to East Sports Ground on 16 November. Please place a provisional hold on the other venues.

subject: Annual technical fest venues
body: Approved: Main Auditorium for 14-16 November, Central Lawn for 14-15 November, and East Sports Ground for outdoor activities on 16 November. Facilities should confirm power and security by 30 October.

subject: Annual technical fest venues
body: Power distribution plan is attached. Security Office, please provide staffing plan by 2 November.

subject: Annual technical fest venues
body: Security staffing confirmed: six guards per shift at Main Auditorium and four at East Sports Ground. One supervisor will coordinate across venues.

subject: UTM maintenance
body: UTM in Materials Testing Lab has unstable load readings and is out of service. Please arrange inspection.

subject: UTM maintenance
body: Technician can visit on 23 September. Inspection and calibration estimate is INR 28,000, excluding parts.

subject: UTM maintenance
body: Approved inspection and calibration up to INR 28,000. Any replacement parts require a separate quote and approval.

subject: UTM maintenance
body: Technician found a damaged load-cell connector. Replacement quote is INR 6,500; separate approval is requested.

subject: UTM maintenance
body: Additional INR 6,500 replacement is approved. Complete repair and calibration certificate by 29 September.

subject: UTM maintenance
body: Connector replaced and calibration completed. UTM passed verification and can be returned to service. Certificate attached.

subject: AI in Manufacturing seminar
body: Seminar planned for 12 November 2026, 10:00-13:00. Please reserve Seminar Hall 2 and arrange projector.

subject: AI in Manufacturing seminar
body: Seminar Hall 2 is available 09:00-14:00. A ceiling projector is installed. Please confirm attendance and seating layout.

subject: AI in Manufacturing seminar
body: Expected attendance is 85. Classroom seating is preferred. Please arrange two wireless microphones and a laptop adapter.

subject: AI in Manufacturing seminar
body: Hall reserved for 12 November, 09:00-14:00. Projector and classroom seating confirmed. Seminar Support will arrange microphones and adapter.

subject: Faculty conference reimbursement
body: I attended National Materials Conference in Pune from 18-20 August. Travel tickets and hotel invoice are attached for reimbursement.

subject: Faculty conference reimbursement
body: Claim is missing return boarding pass and conference attendance certificate. Please submit both.

subject: Faculty conference reimbursement
body: Return boarding pass and attendance certificate are attached. Please confirm completeness.

subject: Faculty conference reimbursement
body: Documents are complete. Eligible reimbursement is INR 24,650 and has been forwarded for approval.

subject: Faculty conference reimbursement
body: Approved reimbursement of INR 24,650 as per institute travel policy. Accounts may process payment.

subject: Faculty conference reimbursement
body: INR 24,650 was transferred on 4 September 2026. Claim is closed.

subject: Department office printers
body: Department office requires two network laser printers. Minimum specifications are attached.

subject: Department office printers
body: Quotes: Printwell INR 32,000 each, OfficeTech INR 29,500 each, PaperPro INR 34,000 each. OfficeTech is lowest; technical review is underway.

subject: Department office printers
body: OfficeTech model supports network printing and duplex features with one-year onsite warranty. All three models meet minimum specifications.

subject: Department office printers
body: Approved two OfficeTech printers at INR 29,500 each, total INR 59,000, from office equipment budget. Issue order by 14 October.

subject: Department office printers
body: Purchase order issued to OfficeTech. Delivery expected by 20 October.

subject: Department office printers
body: Both printers delivered and installed. IT Support verified network printing and duplex operation. Request complete.

subject: Mid-semester examination timetable
body: Mid-semester timetable is being finalized for 2-10 November 2026. Report room or faculty conflicts by 15 October.

subject: Mid-semester examination timetable
body: Manufacturing Processes exam on 5 November at 14:00 has a room conflict because Lab 1 is booked for accreditation. Request Lecture Hall 4.

subject: Mid-semester examination timetable
body: Lecture Hall 4 is available. Exam remains 5 November at 14:00; venue changes from Lab 1 to Lecture Hall 4. Inform students and invigilators.

subject: Mid-semester examination timetable
body: Revised venue circulated to enrolled students and invigilators. Date and time are unchanged.

subject: Research grant consumables budget
body: Sanctioned grant allows INR 3.5 lakh for consumables this financial year. Submit revised itemized plan before placing orders.

subject: Research grant consumables budget
body: Revised consumables plan totals INR 3.42 lakh for sensors, test coupons, and calibration materials. Please confirm eligibility.

subject: Research grant consumables budget
body: Items are eligible under consumables head. INR 3.42 lakh is within INR 3.5 lakh cap. Individual purchase approvals still follow procurement rules.

subject: Research grant consumables budget
body: Revised plan accepted for budget planning only. This is not purchase authorization; submit individual requisitions for approval before ordering.

subject: Engineering Block network outage
body: Users report intermittent connectivity in Engineering Block since 08:30 IST. Please investigate and provide restoration estimate.

subject: Engineering Block network outage
body: Initial checks indicate failed distribution switch on second floor. Replacement unit is available in IT inventory.

subject: Engineering Block network outage
body: Access to second-floor network cabinet is approved. Coordinate power isolation with Facilities before replacement.

subject: Engineering Block network outage
body: Distribution switch replaced and connectivity tests passed at 12:30 IST. Monitoring continues for 24 hours. Helpdesk may close tickets if no further drops occur.
